object.description: On a clean document out of read-only mode, check the Commit action, open the commit dialog and enter tag name CDR-1.0 with a message. Expected: Commit is enabled and opens the dialog; the button reads Tag and the message field is disabled; accepting tags the latest commit, makes no commit (HEAD unchanged), and the status bar says the current commit was tagged.
